## 5. Entity Definitions

### 5.1 Entity: `users`

**Description:** Stores all registered user accounts.
**Source class:** `User` in `database/models.py`

| Attribute | Column | Data Type | PK | FK | NOT NULL | UNIQUE | Default | Description |
|-----------|--------|----------|----|----|----------|--------|---------|-------------|
| User ID | `id` | SERIAL / BIGINT | ✓ | | ✓ | ✓ | auto | Surrogate primary key |
| Email | `email` | VARCHAR(255) | | | ✓ | ✓ | | Login identifier |
| Password Hash | `hashed_password` | VARCHAR(512) | | | ✓ | | | bcrypt hash |
| Full Name | `full_name` | VARCHAR(200) | | | | | NULL | Optional display name |
| Active | `is_active` | BOOLEAN | | | ✓ | | TRUE | Account enabled |
| Admin | `is_admin` | BOOLEAN | | | ✓ | | FALSE | Admin privilege |
| Created | `created_at` | TIMESTAMP WITH TZ | | | ✓ | | NOW() | Record creation |
| Updated | `updated_at` | TIMESTAMP WITH TZ | | | ✓ | | NOW() | Last modification |

**Business Rules:**
- Email must be globally unique across all users
- `is_active = false` prevents login without deleting data
- Passwords must be stored only as bcrypt hashes (never plaintext)

---

### 5.2 Entity: `resources`

**Description:** Primary business entity owned by a user.
**Source class:** `Resource` / `Item` in `database/models.py`

| Attribute | Column | Data Type | PK | FK | NOT NULL | Default | Description |
|-----------|--------|----------|----|----|----------|---------|-------------|
| Resource ID | `id` | SERIAL | ✓ | | ✓ | auto | Primary key |
| Name | `name` | VARCHAR(255) | | | ✓ | | Resource display name |
| Description | `description` | TEXT | | | | NULL | Optional long description |
| Owner | `user_id` | INTEGER | | `users.id` | ✓ | | Resource owner (FK) |
| Status | `status` | ENUM | | | ✓ | `'active'` | active / archived / deleted |
| Created | `created_at` | TIMESTAMP | | | ✓ | NOW() | |
| Updated | `updated_at` | TIMESTAMP | | | ✓ | NOW() | |

**Business Rules:**
- `user_id` must reference an existing, active user
- Deletion sets `status = 'deleted'` (soft delete) — physical row retained
- `updated_at` is updated via a database trigger on every UPDATE

## 6. Join Tables (Many-to-Many)

### 6.1 `resource_tags`

Resolves the many-to-many relationship between `resources` and `tags`.

| Column | Type | FK | Description |
|--------|------|-----|-------------|
| `resource_id` | INTEGER | `resources.id` | References resource |
| `tag_id` | INTEGER | `tags.id` | References tag |

**PRIMARY KEY:** `(resource_id, tag_id)` composite

## 7. Cardinality Rules

| Relationship | Rule |
|-------------|------|
| User → Resources | One user may own zero or more resources |
| Resource → User | Every resource must have exactly one owner |
| Resource → Tags | A resource may have zero or more tags |
| Tag → Resources | A tag may be applied to zero or more resources |
| User → Sessions | A user may have zero or more active sessions |
| Session → User | Every session belongs to exactly one user |

All foreign key relationships enforce **referential integrity** with the following cascade rules:

| Table | Column | References | On Delete | On Update |
|-------|--------|-----------|-----------|-----------|
| `resources` | `user_id` | `users(id)` | CASCADE | CASCADE |
| `sessions` | `user_id` | `users(id)` | CASCADE | CASCADE |
| `resource_tags` | `resource_id` | `resources(id)` | CASCADE | CASCADE |
| `resource_tags` | `tag_id` | `tags(id)` | RESTRICT | CASCADE |
